notes.title: Bloodface is coming in 2025!
notes.notes:
[i]After six months of dedicated development, Bloodface has officially launched its Steam store page!

Developed and published by Iron Forge Games, Bloodface is a Realistic Action RPG set in the medieval era. The game supports 17 languages and offers an immersive experience grounded in realism and intense combat.

Add Bloodface to your Wishlist today to show your support and stay updated on all future announcements!

Exciting news are coming very soon. Stay tuned![/i]

[b]Iron Forge Games[/b]
